stories.title: Russian drone strikes train in Ukraine after Johnson's departure; Trump urges halt to refinery attacks
new_facts: Trump publicly urges Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries citing surging diesel prices.
Ukrainian drone evades Russian helicopter fire to strike an oil tanker, per released footage.
Boris Johnson gives on-record quote condemning Putin over the train strike.
Boris Johnson's train was evacuated after a Russian drone strike hit the Kyiv-Warsaw rail line near the Polish border.
Jared Kushner mocked at diplomatic forum for saying Ukraine should cede Russian-demanded territory.
Overnight barrage of 450+ drones/missiles killed at least six and injured 40+ across Ukraine; foreign minister calls strike 'Putin's terror knocking on EU/Nato doors'.
Russia claims four killed in Ukrainian drone strikes, an updated casualty figure.
Ukrainian and Polish officials describe the rail strikes as a 'systemic attack' on Ukraine's railway network, broadening the campaign beyond fuel sites.
Identifies strike location as Yahodyn, a town just 2km from the Polish border.
stories.line: Russian drone struck a Ukrainian train minutes after Boris Johnson and European officials departed the station; Trump separately called for Ukraine to stop attacking Russian oil refineries.

stories.title: Tax deadline arrives; Social Security funding proposals gain bipartisan support
new_facts: Bipartisan lawmakers considering taxing high earners to fund Social Security amid looming shortfall.
stories.line: Tax deadline arrives tomorrow; separate proposals to shore up Social Security by taxing higher earners are drawing bipartisan interest.

stories.title: Pennsylvania reports third measles death this year
new_facts: 40-year-old unvaccinated woman from Jefferson County, PA, died of measles complications, coroner says.
Death marks PA's third measles death this year; US having worst resurgence in 35 years.
Woman died Saturday; two prior PA deaths were infants, one with a genetic defect.
stories.line: Pennsylvania reports its third measles death this year as the state deals with an active outbreak.

stories.title: Trump rejects AI safety warnings, cites China race
new_facts: Trump publicly dismisses AI existential-risk warnings, calling them from 'negative forces' predicting 'things that won't happen', citing China rivalry.
Trump says guardrails can be placed on AI but insists U.S. cannot lose the AI race to China.
Democrats are escalating attacks on the administration's hands-off AI regulation stance ahead of midterms.
stories.line: Trump dismisses warnings about AI safety risks, prioritizing competition with China over regulatory caution.

stories.title: Céline Dion returns to stage in Paris after Stiff Person Syndrome diagnosis
new_facts: Michelle Obama attended Dion's Paris comeback show, noted for her fashion choices.
Michelle Obama in audience; Dion quoted saying the comeback was harder than expected.
stories.line: Céline Dion performed her first show since being diagnosed with Stiff Person Syndrome, with Michelle Obama in attendance.

stories.title: Trump doubles down on Irish unification remarks amid press criticism
new_facts: Reform (UK party) publicly criticizes Trump's Irish reunification remarks; new quote 'may as well happen now'
New actor (female PA reporter) and scene of Trump dodging a protest question with a bizarre quip
New on-record Trump quotes doubling down on unification and dismissing Burnham's opposition
New story: Trump says he's not worried about Xi Jinping cancelling upcoming summit
New scene: Trump rambling about Scottish windmills when asked about Irish unification remarks; names UK PM Andy Burnham
stories.line: Trump makes unsolicited comments about Irish unification and responds defensively to press scrutiny during Ireland trip.
